task:
Read the two texts below. Write an essay summarising and evaluating the key points from both texts. Use your own words as far as possible, and include your own ideas. Write your answer in 240–280 words.
Text 1: The benefits of remote work
Remote work gives employees greater autonomy over their time. Without commuting, workers can use the hours they save for family, exercise or professional development. Many companies also report that staff are more productive when they can work in an environment that suits them.
Text 2: The risks of remote work
However, working from home can blur the boundary between professional and private life. Employees may feel pressure to be constantly available, while reduced face-to-face contact can weaken teamwork and make career progression less visible. Employers therefore need clear policies to protect staff wellbeing.
essay:
Why I Like Working From Home Very Much
Working from home is a topic what many people are talking about nowadays. In my opinion, I think it is very good and I like it because you can stay in your house and don’t have to go outside. Also, my friend says that working at home is more comfortable than going to office, and I am agree with him.
First of all, remote working have many advantages. People can wake up later because they don’t need commute to the work. This means they have more time for doing whatever they wants, like watching television, playing games or sleeping more. In addition, they can wear comfortable clothes and eat food while they are working, which is something what is not possible in a normal office. My cousin, who is working from home since two years, told me that he never want to go back to an office because he hate traffic and he like his cat sitting next to him during meetings.
Another reason why remote work is good is because of technology. Nowadays, everyone have a laptop and internet, so it is easy for connect with other people. You can send emails, make video calls and share documents very quickly. Some companies says that their workers are more productive at home, but I am not sure if this is true for every person because some people are lazy and they don’t work properly when nobody is watching them.
However, there is also some bad things about working at home. For example, sometimes you cannot stop working because your boss send you messages in the evening and weekend. This can make people very stressed and tired. Also, if you stay at home all the time, you don’t see your colleagues and you can feel alone. I think companies should organize more parties and activities for their employees so they can know each other better.
In conclusion, working from home is a very interesting topic and I believe it will become more popular in the future. People should decide by themselves if they want to work at home or in an office, because everyone is different and have different preferences. Anyway, I prefer working from home because it is more easy and comfortable, and I think governments should encourage more companies to allow their employees to work remotely whenever they want to do it.
